name: Forestry

categories.label: Points on the score track before final scoring
categories.labelVi: Điểm trên track trước khi tính cuối game
categories.hint: Victory points already gained during play (45 in the rulebook example).

categories.label: Buildings
categories.hint: Points printed under the right-most uncovered space of the building track. Count only the highest value, not each building.

categories.label: Water structures
categories.hint: Multiplier = value reached on the water structures track; matches = contract cards, buildings, forester or seedling tokens matching your river tokens.

categories.label: Task cards
categories.hint: Points of each fulfilled task card, read from the third row of the back of the reference tile.

categories.label: Forestry table (forester tokens)
categories.hint: Most forester tokens 10 / second 6 / third 2; ties add the tied ranks and divide equally, rounded down.

categories.label: Unused resources
categories.hint: Count construction material, seedling and temp worker tokens, coins and unfulfilled task cards; 1 VP per complete set of 3.

categories.label: Wood tokens in storage
categories.hint: 1 VP per wood token in storage.

notes: family: point-salad-euro. Game ends after every player takes a final turn once the last round token is flipped. Buildings and task card points come from the reference tile and player board, so they are entered as numbers. The rulebook does not say whether a player with zero forester tokens can place in the forestry table ranking. Solo and forester-character modes are not modelled.
